paite: Aw Israel, TOUPA na Pathian kiang ah kik nawn in, na thulimlouhna ah na pukta hi.
heading: Israel TOUPA Kiang A Kik Dia Chialna
english: Israel, return to Yahweh your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.

paite: Thupha tawi inla, TOUPA kiang ah kik nawn in, "Thulimlouhna tengteng lamang inla, ahehpihna in na sang in; huchi in ka mukte uh thillat bawngtalte bang in ka pe ding uh," akiang ah chi in.
english: Take words with you, and return to Yahweh. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good; so we offer bulls as we vowed of our lips.

paite: Assuria in ahondam kei dia; sakolte tung ah i tuang kei ding uh; i khut ua i bawlte kiang uah, pathiante na hi uh, i chi nawn kei ding hi; nang ah pabeite'n zahngaihna amu uhi.
english: Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for in you the fatherless finds mercy.”

paite: Aginomlouhna uh ka hihdam ding a, amaute athawn in ka it ding, kei a kipan in ka hehna lah akiheimangta ngal a.
heading: Israel Tunding Chiamna
english: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from them.

paite: Israel lak ah daitui bang ka hi ding, lili pak bang in apaklun dia, Lebanon sing bang in zungkip akakhesuk ding hi.
english: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.

paite: Ahiangte abawkpha dia, akilawmna olive sing bang ahi dia, agim Lebanon bang ahi ding hi.
english: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.

paite: Alimnuai a tengte ahong kik nawn ding ua, buh-le-bal bang in ahong hing thak ding ua, grepgui bang in apaklun ding; agim Lebanon uain bang ahi ding.
english: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.

paite: Milimte bang ding ka chi nawnta dia? Ephraim in achi ding hi. Ka dawng khin a, amah ka limsak ding, meilah sing hing bang ka hi a; kei a kipan na gah muh ahi.
english: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree; from me your fruit is found.”

paite: Kua ahia pil a, hiai thilte theithei ding? Pilvang a amaute thei ding? TOUPA lampite adik a, huaite ah midiktat a-om ding a; himahleh talekte huai ah apuk ding uhi.
heading: Thukhitna
english: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are right, and the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.
